claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified now on the strength of aggregate launch readiness and zero severity-one rehearsal incidents, with the clinical-trial intake gap treated as a documented and monitored residual risk rather than a blocker.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the certification satisfies the release policy threshold for this material limitation.
Treat the weakness as material because it affects a named launch use case and contractual customer segment.

General aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents support overall readiness but do not satisfy the separate disclosure or risk-acceptance requirement for a material named-use-case gap.
Pending legal review and missing proof of disclosure or approved risk acceptance prevent concluding full compliance.
evidence_requests: Produce the final legal determination on whether the clinical-trial intake gap must be disclosed.
Produce the actual pre-launch disclosure or model-card text covering this named limitation, if it exists.
Produce an approved risk-acceptance record explicitly covering this gap for the two named hospital pilot commitments.
Produce evidence that the clinical-trial intake gap was remediated or re-evaluated to target before certification.
specific_concerns: Admissible evidence shows the affected clinical-trial intake segment is named in two hospital pilot commitments, which makes the weakness material under the stated policy.
The product note calling the segment non-core does not resolve materiality for named customer commitments.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed is still open, so a required policy predicate remains unresolved.
No admissible evidence shows the limitation was resolved, disclosed before launch, or covered by approved risk acceptance, even though policy requires one of those conditions.
Public guidance about documenting limitations and monitoring risk is general and does not override the release policy for material limitations in named launch use cases.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on admissible evidence alone.
That the clinical-trial intake limitation can already be treated as a bounded residual risk for launch without proof of disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
That general model-card and AI risk-management guidance is sufficient support for this specific certification decision under the internal materiality policy.
